MODEL NOTES

A useful starting point.
An honest level of accuracy.

This is a real mesh model, built in code at full scale. It represents the original Catalina 22 arrangement, using a 1977 factory brochure as the principal reference. Your boat’s exact year and alterations have not been confirmed.

DimensionModel valueBasis
Hull length6.5532 m / 21′6″Published
Maximum hull beam2.3368 m / 7′8″Published
Reference waterline5.8928 m / 19′4″Published reference*
Keel draft, raised0.6096 m / 2′0″Published
Keel draft, lowered1.524 m / 5′0″Published
Mast length7.62 m / 25′0″Published

*The reference waterline is a dimension guide, not a hydrostatic solution. Overall boat length with rudder and hardware exceeds the hull length.

Reconstructed, not measured

Hull cross-sections, freeboard, bulkhead positions, berth sizes, cabin and window shapes, keel pivot and blade profile, galley travel, and fittings are approximations guided by the brochure drawing and photographs. These are not factory CAD surfaces or fabrication dimensions.

The earlier restoration layout contains proposed equipment locations in diagram units. Those have not been treated as physical measurements or installed equipment in this model.

To match your boat

Confirm the year and keel type, then measure the cabin entry, main bulkheads, berth ends and heights, cockpit opening, and galley footprint from a common reference. The separate named parts and editable code make those corrections straightforward.
